title: CAVA’s 2025 Impact Update: Growing with Heart, Health, and Humanity
summary: Surpassing $1 million in donations, the company is expanding investments in team members, communities, and sustainable scaling CAVA, (NYSE: CAVA) the category-defining Mediterranean fast-casual restaurant brand, today released its 2025 Impact Update, detailing the company’s continued commitment to people development, community support, culinary innovation, and sustainable growth. The report reflects a milestone year for the company, surpassing $1 billion in revenue for the first time in 2025 while opening 72 net new restaurants across the country.
